outcome: Income schedules: read the live schedule and record the review decision
acceptance_criteria: `/work/4203` (Next 4990, mock 4991) shows the stage and finding, the income rows with their amounts, the result block and the Decide panel with exactly Approve, Return and Reject buttons — verify: open the page; `frontend/e2e/income-schedules.spec.ts`.

Against live Django (8030) a real `income_schedules` work item shows the same stage, finding, row keys and result totals as `GET /api/v1/work/{id}/finance-schedule` — verify: compare the page with `curl` JSON using the session.
A row with `amount: null` and a result total of null show "Unknown", never 0 or an empty cell — verify: `/work/4201` and a unit test on the row mapper.
The page performs no arithmetic on money: no total, difference or count is computed (`grep` for `parseFloat|Number(` on amounts in the new files returns nothing) — verify: grep and code review.

The Decide panel shows only the verdicts in `review_verdicts[]`: `4203` shows three buttons, `4205` shows only "Withdraw approval", `4201`, `4204` and `4206` show none; an unknown verdict string draws no button — verify: unit test and e2e.

With `review_hold_code: "reviewer_missing"` (`4206`) the page says nobody is set to review schedules and shows no Decide panel, reviewer name or Setup link; `review_rule_missing` shows its own sentence — verify: e2e and unit test on both codes.

A decision is not sent without a chosen evidence record and a note; Approve is no exception, and the buttons stay disabled with the reason shown — verify: unit test asserts no fetch call; e2e tries Approve with each missing.

Pressing Approve on `4203` with evidence 61 and a note sends exactly one `POST /api/v1/work/4203/reviews` with `{kind:"schedule", expected_revision:5, case_revision:12, target_id:9, verdict:"approve", evidence_id:61, note}` and the `X-CSRFToken` header — verify: network panel and unit test on `body()`.
After a 200 the page re-reads and shows what the re-read says; it does not show "verified" from the write response alone — verify: mock where the re-read returns the old state; unit test.
A 409 shows "This schedule changed while you were reading it, so nothing was recorded", re-reads, and keeps the person's note and evidence choice — verify: mock scenario.

A dropped connection or 503 after the press shows the unconfirmed notice, keeps the buttons disabled until the re-read returns, and sends the decision once only — verify: mock scenario; count POST calls.
A 403 `csrf_failed` refreshes the session once, says to press again, and does not show the no-access state or retry by itself — verify: mock scenario; count calls.
A 404 on the read or the write shows "This record is unavailable." with the same words for a missing and a not-yours schedule (`4299`), no title and no further call — verify: both cases side by side.
A 422 with `fields[]` shows the first field message next to the form and keeps the input — verify: mock scenario.

`evidence[]` empty shows the "no evidence to cite" message and no buttons; the evidence select offers only `evidence[]` rows and the page has no file input or free-text evidence id — verify: component test.

`4204` shows the returned rows and "Returned for correction" and no correct-and-resubmit control; no quoted note appears unless the read carries one — verify: e2e; grep the new files for `correct_and_resubmit` and `liveApi.POST` (only the reviews call).
`duplicates[]` lines are shown read only under "Possible duplicates"; there is no settle control — verify: `4202` e2e.
An `inventory` item (`4207`) shows coverage as returned and its schedules read only with no button; an `income` read draws no inventory block — verify: e2e.

"Posted to the ledger", "Export as an adjustment" and "Withdraw approval" text for export appear nowhere except the revoke button, and the build note says "Posted to ledger: NO" is hidden because the read has no field — verify: grep of the new files; `build.md`.

A hold code or verdict list is never invented: with `review_hold_code: null` and `review_verdicts: []` (`4205` without revoke) the page shows no panel and no "reviewer not set" text — verify: unit test.

Viewport check at 1440 and 390 against the SCR-54 investigating, held, review, returned and verified boards: parts that remain match; hidden parts leave no empty heading or gap — verify: screenshots at both widths against `design/screens.md` SCR-54.

New tests exist for the adapter's `sections` and `commands` (including null tokens staying null), the note and evidence gate, and each error mapping — verify: `delivery/checks.sh` runs them green, with `api-live-schema-drift` still passing.

risk.rationale: Medium. The change is cross-layer (v7 mock to live bodies) and the review write goes through auth, evidence and revision checks (`reviews`), but it does not post to the ledger or move money. The high-risk actions (duplicate settlement, adjustment export) sit in F-101B. Merge goes to the design engineer's batch if the reviewers treat the finance review write as money-adjacent (D-180/D-184). Otherwise it can merge routinely. Source: connection map `### SCR-54`, backend answers E-21 and E-22.
